elements_selected.content: Implement text-file persistence: append S-expression messages to file (one per line, self-delimiting). Recovery: parse sequentially via Layer 1 DCFL recogniser, compute content hashes using canonical form (not file form), append to store with deduplication, rebuild hash index, reconstruct frontier. Handle truncated writes (parser fails on unbalanced parens, skips). Integrity verification on recovery (recompute hashes, check :caused-by). File compaction after checkpoint via atomic file replacement. Persistence is optional (in-memory valid for ephemeral agents). REQ-314.
